description: This file contains unit tests for the ContactsHandler component in an Android app, validating contact search and addition functionalities using Robolectric framework.

classes.name: ContactsHandlerTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the ContactsHandler class, verifying contact search and add behaviors.

classes.name: FakeContactsDataSource
classes.description: A mock implementation of ContactsDataSource for testing purposes, simulating permission checks, search results, and contact addition.

methods.name: handleContactsSearch_requiresReadPermission
methods.description: Tests that contact search requires read permission and returns an error if permission is missing.

methods.name: handleContactsAdd_rejectsEmptyContact
methods.description: Tests that adding an empty contact (with only a space as givenName) results in validation error.

methods.name: handleContactsSearch_returnsContacts
methods.description: Validates that a contact search returns the expected contact data when search results are available.

methods.name: handleContactsAdd_returnsAddedContact
methods.description: Checks that adding a valid contact returns the correct contact data and increments addCalls counter.
